name: fairbuild-sub-compliance
description: Fairbuild Sub Compliance: each active subcontractor's compliance documents against your list and the extra ones its trade needs (W-9, signed subcontract, licences, safety program, EMR letter and others you name): missing, expired, expiring, rejected, waiting too long for review, and safety ratings above your limit. Drafts document requests. Never approves or blocks a vendor.
